subject: Entry-name clause
notes: "Data-name-1 shall not be qualified or subscripted." (cite.py --check 13.18.20.3 OK, rule 1). dataName is a single cobolWord/FILLER token with no qualifier or subscript alternative, so the declaration slot cannot carry either: probe/entry-name-clause/p4.cob `05 A OF G PIC X(3).` -> COBOL0001 near 'OF'; p5.cob `05 A(1) PIC X(3).` -> COBOL0001 near '('. Report group name (cobolWord) likewise. Rejection is a generic parse error, not a named diagnostic — acceptable for a syntax rule. No spec-derived negative test pins it. || Editions (adjudicator): 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the clause's own text; Annex E records no change to the entry-name clause)
